P.name: Relentless Assault
P.title: Template:Data Jax/Relentless Assault
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Relentless Assault|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jax
|skill        = I
|icon         = Relentless Assault.png
|icon3        = Jax Grandmaster at Angling.png
|blurbicon    = Relentless Assault.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Jax}} {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|stacks}}, up to a cap. Stacks expire one at a time.
|blurb4       = {{sbc|Relentless Assault:}} For each stack, '''Jax''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Jax's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Relentless Assault'' {{tip|on-attack}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.25}} seconds when the duration ends.
|description2 = {{sbc|Relentless Assault:}} For each stack, '''Jax''' gains {{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|5 to 14 for 7|1 to 19}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|40 to 112 for 7|1 to 19}}|attack speed}}.
|description3 = {{sbc|Grandmaster at Angling:}} While out-of-combat with champions and idle in the river for 10 seconds, '''Jax''' will occasionally catch a fish, granting him {{g|1}} and {{as|1 ability power}} for 5 seconds. He catches a fish at an average rate of one every 15 seconds. He also has a 5% chance to catch a [[File:Jax Grandmaster at Angling 2.png|link=|20 px]] rare fish that grants {{g|10}} and {{as|10 ability power}} for 5 seconds.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = 
|spelleffects = 
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = 
|parry        = 
|notes        =
* '''Jax''' will start fishing while idle in the river if he is in-combat with only monsters (e.g. Epic monsters).{{bug|1}}
* '''Jax''' catching a fish is a random event and will play a special animation.
* The total number of fish caught during the game is displayed when fishing as {{ai|Relentless Assault|Jax|Grandmaster at Angling|image=Grandmaster at Angling.png}} passive.
* ''Relentless Assault'' uses its [[File:Jax Relentless Assault old2.png|link=|20 px]] old icon in the [[Death Recap]].<!--don't ask how this happens-->
}}

E.name: Counter Strike
E.title: Template:Data Jax/Counter Strike
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Counter Strike|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Jax |skill = E |icon = Counter Strike.png |blurbicon = Counter Strike.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jax}} enters ''Evasion'' for a short time: a defensive stance that causes him to {{tip|dodge}} all incoming non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks and take reduced damage from all {{tip|area of effect}} abilities from {{tip|champions}}. |blurb2 = ''Counter Strike'' can be recast within this time, and does so automatically after the duration. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jax''' deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} nearby enemies, the damage is increased if he dodged more attacks. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' enters ''Evasion'' for 2 seconds: a defensive stance that causes him to {{tip|dodge}} all incoming non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks and take 25% reduced damage from all {{tip|area of effect}} {{tip|abilities}} sourced from {{tip|champions}}.

''Counter Strike'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration. |description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Jax''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, with the '''total''' damage increased by 20% for each attack dodged, up to a 100% increase, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second. |leveling2 = {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 160}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 160*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}} |effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 375 |cooldown = {{ap|17 to 9}} |cdstart = post-effect |cost = {{ap|50 to 90}} |cast time = None |costtype = Mana |targeting = Auto |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = magic |spelleffects = aoe |onhiteffects = |spellshield = True |notes = * The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive. * ''Counter Strike'' will also dodge abilities that can trigger {{tip|on-hit}} effects ({{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank}}, {{ai|Mystic Shot|Ezreal}}) which will count towards ''Counter Strike's'' increased damage. There are exceptions of abilities that ''Counter Strike'' will not dodge but will dodge the damage from {{tip|on-hit}} effects that they trigger ({{ai|Alpha Strike|Master Yi}}, {{ai|Piercing Darkness|Senna}}). * The damage based on the target's maximum health is capped at 9000 against {{tip|monsters}}. This is a placeholder value and impossible to reach because it requires a monster to have over {{as|128571 health}}. }}

R.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
R.title: Template:Data Jax/Grandmaster-at-Arms
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Grandmaster-at-Arms|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jax
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|blurbicon    = Jax Grandmaster-at-Arms.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Jax}} {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|stacks}}. At max stacks, he consumes them to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' swings his lantern around, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits a champion, he gains '''bonus''' resistances. He applies his passive {{tip|on-hit}} every 2 stacks instead of every 3 while active.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Jax's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' {{tip|on-hit}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, his next basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and consume all stacks to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}, reduced to 50% against {{tip|structures}}. While ''Grandmaster-at-Arms'' is active, the empowered attack triggers at 1 stack instead.
|leveling     = {{st|Additional Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 185}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
|icon2        = Jax Grandmaster-at-Arms.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jax''' swings his lantern around, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits a champion, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, increased for each champion hit beyond the first, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to 60% of that amount as well as 10% increased {{tip|size}} for 8 seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 250}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Armor|{{ap|45 to 75}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|45*0.6 to 75*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Armor per Champion Hit|{{ap|20 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Bonus Magic Resistance per Champion Hit|{{ap|20*0.6 to 30*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description3 = '''''Jax''' can move during Grandmaster-at-Arms' cast time.''
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 375
|cooldown     = {{ap|110 to 90}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = mana
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = special
|parry        = Special
|notes        =
* The on-hit deals {{tip|proc damage}}. The swing deals {{tip|area damage}}.
* The bonus resistances are represented by a glowing aura around '''Jax''' that grows with each enemy champion hit beyond the first.
* The {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}} but it cannot {{tip|blind|miss}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the additional damage from the third attack if it is {{ai|Empower|Jax|empowered}}.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|wards}}.
** Stacks will still be generated when attacking them.
* The empowered attack is applied in a separate damage instance from '''Jax's''' basic attacks.
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} to be applied twice.{{bug|2}}
* {{Effect at cast time end}}
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Jax_Original_R_0.ogg}} ''"Show me '''all your might!'''"''
}}
